Accordion

accordion()

The full package: 20 production-ready HTML pages, the SCSS source, every ES module unminified, the build tooling, the generated artwork, and this documentation. No obfuscation, no phone-home scripts, no build step required to use it.

No. There is not a single line of jQuery in the package. Interactivity is plain ES modules, plus exactly two of Bootstrap 5.3’s own vanilla components — Modal and Offcanvas. Dropdowns, tabs, collapse and alerts are implemented in the template, which is what keeps Popper.js out of the bundle entirely.

It uses the native Bootstrap 5.3 colour-mode API. The switcher writes data-bs-theme on the html element and remembers your choice in localStorage; if you have never chosen, it follows your operating system.
